external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Bernie Marcus, The Home Depot’s first CEO and chairman, retired from his position in 2002. Moved by his desire to give, he founded the Marcus Foundation. Since 2009, Mr. Marcus has generously donated his time and hundreds of millions of dollars to organizations like Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta, the Shepherd Center, and even Turning Point USA.

Bernie Marcus, The Home Depot’s first CEO and chairman, retired from his position in 2002. Moved by his desire to give, he founded the Marcus Foundation. Since 2009, Mr. Marcus has generously donated his time and hundreds of millions of dollars to organizations like Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta, the Shepherd Center, and even Turning Point USA.

Philanthropists and co-founders of The Home Depot, Bernie Marcus and Arthur Blank, have partnered with The Gary Sinise Foundation to launch The Gary Sinise Foundation Avalon Network to provide assistance for military veterans, first responders, and their families who suffer from post-traumatic stress, TBI, and substance abuse.

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Turning Point USA’s Asset Management Department is responsible for all Turning Point assets both owned and operated. In addition, this department manages the oversight and development of all operational facilities. This includes the Turning Point Headquarters in Phoenix, Arizona, Turning Point USA Embassy in Washington, D.C, and the Legacy Center in Lemont, IL.
